The by-id path ending 5B7A030191 is user-provided deployment data and must be rechecked on Jetson. Production sequence is pick-feedback-confirm -> MAGNET_ON/status-confirm -> release-feedback-confirm -> MAGNET_OFF/status-confirm. physical_pick_verified remains false until post-move visual evidence.
